jtbd.jtbd_title: UC essay final polish + MIT framing
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Remove clichés, lock authentic metaphors, and frame MIT supplements around concrete proof.

interactions.user_ask: How do I remove clichés without losing voice?
interactions.jenny_reply: Swap abstractions with scene-first specifics; keep one image if it ties to a concrete build moment.

interactions.user_ask: What should anchor the MIT supplement?
interactions.jenny_reply: Lead with shipped artifacts (demo clip + README) before values; proof-over-prose.
Use the last-50 rule: prune from the back; remove preambles and hedges first.

outcomes.name: uc_final_polish_v3
outcomes.details: Clichés removed; tone consistent; scenes prioritized.

outcomes.name: mit_supplemental_outline_v1
outcomes.details: Outline leading with shipped artifacts; placeholders for links.
